The '''Dorne family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A highly prestigious family with a history of Imperial service, the Dorne family counted [[Vasil Dorne]] and his children, [[Aleksei Dorne|Aleksei]] and [[Elara Dorne|Elara]], among its members. Like many other influential families within the Sith Empire, the Dorne family owned slaves.<ref name="TOR ElaraAmb">{{TORcite|type=other|Elara Dorne ambient dialogue on Rishi}}</ref>
